statistical_disclaimer: Planned target counts reflect institutional collaboration targets only; statistical power, multi-site variance, and minimum cohort adequacy are NOT fabricated in code and require formal biostatistician & IEC/IRB sign-off.

proposed_patient_level_split_allocation.external_site_holdout_note: Independent collaborating hospital centers reserved for external_test evaluation; BTXRD Center 2 (N=549) & Center 3 (N=259) permanently excluded from Track D train/val.
strict_rules: Zero patient overlap across train, val, internal_test, or external_test.
Zero cross-modality pooling (xray, bone_scan, and ct cohorts partitioned and modeled per modality stream).

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: Multi-center >=2 oncology & tertiary MSK radiology centers (planned target; 0 sites active)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Adults >=18y with biopsy-confirmed OR multimodal PET-CT/MRI-confirmed secondary bone metastasis (lytic, blastic, or mixed) imaged on >=1024x1024 CR/DR DICOM.
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Primary bone sarcomas (osteosarcoma, Ewing, chondrosarcoma), multiple myeloma, unconfirmed primary tumor, BTXRD Center 2/3 holdouts.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: Patient-level Track D X-ray 4-class differential sensitivity, specificity, macro-F1, and calibrated ECE.

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: TCIA Spine-Mets-CT-SEG (55 external subjects upon DUA) + >=1 hospital CT archive (planned)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Volumetric helical bone-window CT (slice thickness <= 1.5 mm) with confirmed secondary vertebral or appendicular metastasis.
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Primary spinal tumors, non-bone-window low-res reconstructions, unverified metastases.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: Pathway C CT differential classification and 3D lesion segmentation Dice / fracture geometry fidelity.

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: IICS-UNA Paraguay (60 metastasis subjects pending Track D verification) + multi-primary hospital nuclear medicine cohort (planned)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Paired Anterior + Posterior 99mTc-MDP planar whole-body scintigraphy across diverse solid primaries (breast, prostate, lung, renal).
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Unpaired single-view scans, Stage 14 burned test holdout patients, degenerative trauma confounding labeled as metastasis.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: Pathway B scintigraphy patient-level sensitivity/specificity across non-breast and breast primaries.

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: Multi-center MSK hospital collaboration >=2 international/national metabolic bone registries (planned; 0 sites active)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Adults >=40y meeting classic radiographic triad confirmed by >=2 MSK radiologists + biochemical serum ALP/BSAP or biopsy.
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Osteoarthritis, subchondral sclerosis, fibrous dysplasia, osteopetrosis, blastic metastasis mimics, Radiopaedia/MedPix web images.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: Patient-level Paget's vs Metastasis differential specificity and macro-F1.

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: RDCRN BBDC Protocol 7701 (pending DAC) + >=1 tertiary pediatric orthopedic genetics hospital (planned)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Confirmed human OI (genetic COL1A1/COL1A2 track OR Sillence Type I/III/IV specialist diagnosis recorded separately), pediatric ethics & consent verified.
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Animal/murine micro-CT, osteoporosis, osteopenia, rickets, osteomalacia, non-accidental trauma.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: Patient-level OI classification balanced across pediatric growth-plate strata without shortcut learning.

planned_cohorts.institution_distribution: Stanford AIMI MURA (upper-extremity comparator pending DUA) + hospital PACS matched normal pelvis/spine/lower-limb/pediatric controls (planned)
planned_cohorts.inclusion_criteria: Asymptomatic normal skeletal radiographs with explicit radiologist normal sign-off, documented anatomical_region, control_selection_criteria, and normal skeletal history.
planned_cohorts.exclusion_criteria: Contralateral trauma/cancer limbs, absence-of-fracture assumptions (FracAtlas), oncology staging patients, osteoporosis/implants.
planned_cohorts.primary_endpoint: False-positive rate across anatomically matched skeletal sites (pelvis, spine, extremities) and pediatric/adult age strata.
